In one particularly deep chasm lies the remnants of a powerful [[Bloodstone|magical stone]], said to be a relic from the time when the [[Gods of Tyria|gods]] walked on [[Tyria]]. [[Bloodstone Fen (outpost)|Bloodstone Fen]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]].

==Getting There==
*Head west from the [[Druid's Overlook]] outpost, through the [[Mamnoon Lagoon]] and then through [[Silverwood]].
*Go north then west through Silverwood from the [[Quarrel Falls]] outpost.
*The mission [[The Wilds]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Bloodstone Fen]]
**This mission is the eleventh mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the second mission in the [[Maguuma Jungle]] region.
